What if you ate raw cookie dough every day?
Licking the spoon is a favorite part of baking for lots of people. It tastes amazing. Most people only worry about raw eggs and salmonella.

But here's the twist. It's not just the raw eggs. Raw flour can carry E coli too, so the FDA says don't eat raw dough, unless it's made to be eaten raw! Heat treated flour and pasteurized eggs make dough safe to eat raw. In twenty sixteen, millions of pounds of flour were recalled in the US because of E coli.
